## Why This Is Asked
Tests capability to design multi-tenant ML pipelines with governance, security, and observability in GCP.

## Key Concepts
- Tenant isolation: per-tenant datasets and access controls
- Data masking: de-identification in Dataflow
- Model hosting: Vertex AI with per-tenant endpoints or tenant-scoped filters
- Explainability: Vertex Explainable AI attributions
- Lineage & governance: Data Catalog, BigQuery metadata
- Drift & rollback: per-tenant drift triggers and rollback paths

## Code Example
```python
# Dataflow-like de-identification sketch (pseudo)
class Deidentify(DoFn):
  def process(self, element):
    import json
    rec = json.loads(element)
    rec['ssn'] = mask(rec.get('ssn'))
    rec.pop('name', None)
    yield json.dumps(rec)
```
